For those who have played MMMORPGs: How often do raid bosses feel like a challenge and how often do bosses feel like farming subjects?

Some bosses are challenging the first time.

They are only challenging the first time. The problem with MMO's is that the mechanics almost never change. Take FF14 as an example-It's the one I have played the most.

All the bosses will do is:

A Tank Buster move that the tank has to buff for and the healers have to heal through

A Big Ultimate attack halfway through you have to do the mechanics to get through, which is killing adds in a set amount of time.

Melee range aoes to make melee dps move and slow dps

Ranged aoes to make ranged dps move and slow dps

This is how every raid boss in FF14 functions. Once you learn the pattern and timing you can do them on farm all day if you have a group that wants to do it. The only challenge is finding out the pattern and timing....which has been drastically reduced because as soon as something is released there are youtube videos on how to beat it.
